title: Bounded-parameter learning program
statement: For a dimension $n$, a rational learning parameter $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$, and a natural number $M$, define a query-access learning program as follows: when $M>0$, it is the Kushilevitz–Mansour program with parameters $\varepsilon$ and $M$; when $M=0$, it returns the empty sparse Fourier hypothesis.
